title: The fibre functor at the geometric point is an equivalence
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\neq p$, an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\Ql$, a finite extension $E/\Ql$ in $\Qlb$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $n\geq1$; put $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ and $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$. Each of the four fibre functors of [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point]

$$
\operatorname{Fib}_s:D^b_c(s,A_{E,n})\to D^b_{\mathrm{fin}}(A_{E,n}),\quad
\operatorname{Fib}_s:D^b_c(s,\mathcal O_E)\to D^b_{\mathrm{fg}}(\mathcal O_E),\quad
\operatorname{Fib}_s:D^b_c(s,E)\to D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(E),\quad
\operatorname{Fib}_s:D^b_c(s,\Qlb)\to D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(\Qlb)
$$

is an equivalence of categories which commutes with the shifts and carries distinguished triangles to distinguished triangles. Here the source categories are those of [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility], [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] and [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients] for $Y=s$, and the targets those of [def-weil-point-finite-cohomology-complexes], [def-weil-point-fg-complete-complexes], [def-weil-point-fd-complexes] and [def-weil-point-fd-qlbar-category].

proof.text: Construct the actual constant-module functor on the pro-etale point, composed with the inverse of the existing intrinsic module encoding. Its adjunction with pointFiniteSections is the constant-sheaf/final-object adjunction composed with the encoding equivalence. The already proved constantSheafEquivalenceOfIsSepClosed from the adopted Kunneth/Ordinary module and the fully faithful finite etale/pro-etale comparison make this constant functor fully faithful; the separate set-valued algebraically-closed-point lemma is not needed. Finite-ring constructible origin shows that its counit is invertible on every constructible sheaf; constant finite modules are constructible by the constant-module comparison theorem. The coefficient quotient is finite by the existing finite coefficient-ring instance.

Apply the termwise adjunction to complexes and descend it along the exact-functor localization squares. Its unit is invertible on all objects because the underived constant functor is fully faithful. Homology identifies the counit with the sheaf-level counit on each constructible cohomology sheaf, so it too is invertible. Constant realization preserves the finite-support condition and finite constructibility. Restrict the adjunction along the fully faithful inclusions, using the explicit unit and counit comparison formulas. The resulting adjunction is an equivalence, with the specified pointFiniteFibre as its right adjoint.

source.place: Torsion equivalence, derived restriction in steps 3-5

proof.text: Use pointIntegralSections_conservative, with the finite equivalence at each level, to detect zero integral constructible objects. For a morphism whose section image is invertible, its distinguished cone has zero section image, hence is zero; therefore sections reflect isomorphisms. The completed perfect-realization adjunction has invertible unit. Applying its right adjoint to the counit gives an isomorphism by the adjunction triangle identity. Reflection of isomorphisms makes the counit invertible. Thus this adjunction is an equivalence with the specified integral fibre as right adjoint.

Copy the specified rational fibre to its prescribed integral-rational object map, using the defining object equalities. Every tensor in a localization tensor module has a single pure-tensor representative, by the localized-module/tensor equivalence. The normalized rational Hom calculation therefore identifies the copied functor on every morphism, not just integral maps. Its additive Hom isomorphisms give fullness and faithfulness, and the lattice theorem gives essential surjectivity. Transport the equivalence back along the copyObj isomorphism.

Each actual finite-stage fibre is the rational equivalence followed by scalar extension along the Shrink coefficient ring equivalence. Field tensor tower and unit isomorphisms give an explicit inverse to the latter. Transport the target filtered two-colimit cocone along these stage equivalences. A functor with its prescribed object and common-stage map formula is an equivalence: Hom surjectivity is the cocone homSurj property; equality of two common-stage maps becomes equality at a later stage by homInj; object surjectivity is essSurjObj. The displayed pointQbarFibreRepresentative formula is exactly the transported cocone conjugation, by functoriality and associativity. Hence the specified Qbar fibre is an equivalence.

The finite and integral exactness clauses are the exact derived section functors after the source inclusions. Use rational-fibre exactness for the rational clause. For Qbar, the stage shift/descent lemma supplies a shift comparison and exactness on source-stage images. The actual common-stage distinguished-triangle description presents every source distinguished triangle as isomorphic to such an image. Apply the fibre and target realization to the inverse of this triangle isomorphism and compose it with the stage witness. This gives precisely the witness required by pointFdQbarDistinguished, including the last arrow.
